headline: Western Isles and Central Fronts Erupt in Fresh Base Clashes
war_summary: Since the afternoon dispatch, the brief operational lull in the center has broken as Linn of Mercy resumed active fighting, logging three base exchanges across Outwich Ranch and Lathair alongside thirteen hundred casualties over the past two hours. Simultaneously, the western maritime fronts have ignited: Fisherman's Row recorded four swift base transitions at Oceanwatch, while Nevish Line sustained six sharp contests around Tomb Father and Grief Mother amid heavy troop deployments. In contrast, the furious exchanges previously seen in Palantine Berm and Godcrofts have quieted during the latest watch, though sustained attrition endures. Nowhere is that attrition more punishing than in Callahan's Passage, where casualty lists surged by nearly forty-five hundred fallen in two hours despite frozen lines, echoed by stubborn grinding in the Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse—the latter marking another seizure at Spirit Watch. With combat accelerating along both island approaches and central road junctions, tactical instability remains widespread across the contested sectors.
